title: Positive Circuit Size
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and gates in topological order, where each gate at position $i$ reads only vertices indexed below $n+i$ and the output index is below $n$ plus the number of gates. If the size of $C$ is the number of inputs plus the number of gates, then its size is at least $1$.
